about.title: About Salt and Light United
about.subtitle: Discover who we are, what we believe, and why we exist.

us.title: About Us
us.p1: We are Salt and Light United! A Christ-centered community of students and young people based in Baliwag City who desire to know Jesus, grow in His Word, and live out our faith together.
us.p2: We believe that lives are transformed through Christ, and that every believer is called to be the salt of the earth and the light of the world (Matthew 5:13–16).
us.p3: Whether you're exploring faith, returning to God, or looking for a place to grow, you're welcome here.

about.missionText: To raise a generation of young people who are rooted in God's Word, empowered by the Holy Spirit, and united in love to be salt and light in their schools, families, and communities.
about.visionText: A thriving community of young believers who transform their generation for Christ — living with purpose, walking in faith, and shining God's light wherever they go.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: Salt and Light United began as a small gathering of young people in Baliwag who shared a common heart — to know God more deeply and to live out their faith together. What started as a handful of teens meeting after school grew into a vibrant youth fellowship.
story.p2: Named after Jesus' words in Matthew 5:13–16, SLU has always been about more than weekly meetings. It's about building a family where young people feel seen, known, and encouraged to become who God created them to be.

leaders.title: Who Runs SLU?
leaders.subtitle: No pastors or formal leaders — just a community serving together
leaders.cardText: SLU is led by its community of young people serving together. We're not a church with a pastor — we're a hangout fellowship where everyone pitches in, organizes events, and shapes the community together.

about.independence: *Salt and Light United (SLU) is not related nor affiliated to any school, college, university, organizations, churches, or denominations; as it is an independent Christian community as of 2026.
